units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 6:3:2">Y. Kil. VI, 30ᶜ</cite> <he>אם … לפסע בין פ׳ לפ׳ וכ׳</he> if he is in the habit of stepping from one trellis to the other (in one step), they are considered (for purposes of mixed seeds, <cite ref="K00674"><he>כִּלְאַיִם</he></cite>) as one espalier; [Levy quotes <cite ref="Q00784"><he>פִּיפְיוֹר</he></cite>.]—Pl. f. <cite ref="A02702"><he>פִּיפָרוֹת</he></cite>.
